title: Circular - Online Mentioning Platform Access Enabled for Parties In Persons
text:
KEY LINES:
07/06/2020 with new facilities added as per circular dated 29/07/2020.

FULL TEXT:
HIGH COURT OF GUJARAT
CIRCULAR
Date: 29th October, 2020
Subject: Online Mentioning Portal - Parties-in-Person can also
submit request for online mentioning
With regard to the a subject given above, this is to inform all concerned that,
Honourable the Chief Justice has been pleased to direct that, on the lines of the
online mentioning platform being used by the Ld. Advocates, Parties-in-Person
should also be allowed access to the mentioning platform, to submit requests for
online mentioning.
Accordingly, the requisite modifications in the online mentioning platform
have been done so that a Party-in-Person, whose mobile number is registered, may
can also submit request for online mentioning using their Party-In-Person Code
number and the OTP that would be sent on the registered mobile number. The
Mentioning link is available on the Case Status page of High Court website on
http://gujarathc-casestatus.nic.in/gujarathc/.
The method to use the platform has been given in the User Guide dated
07/06/2020 with new facilities added as per circular dated 29/07/2020.
REGISTRAR GENERAL
